## Software Developer

I write simple software to solve complex problems. At work I write scripts and
programs to integrate aerospace-aware sensors with situational-awareness
interfaces.

### Senior Software Engineer - AX Enterprize (2021-present)

Senior engineer on SAFIRE/CLUE, a real-time airspace-awareness platform
integrating aerospace sensors for DoD and commercial UAS markets. Designed and
implemented core backend services in Go: authentication and SSO, the track
storage and replay pipeline, and hot/cold data archival. Wrote engineering
tooling in Go and Python - a high-performance packet fan-out router for sensor
feeds, UTM and kinematic track simulators for testing, and an offline terrain
and imagery generation engine for air-gapped deployments.

Skills: Go, Rust, Python, JavaScript, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL

### Lead Programmer / Analyst - SUNY Polytechnic Institute (2016-2021)

Built and maintained software and reports in Ellucian Banner to facilitate
academic success and student retention. Architected and maintained campus-wide
authentication systems and synchronizations. Provided data-driven solutions to
drive institutional planning.

Skills: Python, Oracle, Java, C#

### Web Developer - SUNY Polytechnic Institute (2010-2016)

Oversaw the upgrade of a legacy content management system between major versions
of PHP and its eventual migration to WordPress. Served as the main point of
escalation for website-related support requests. Managed web and database
servers.

Skills: PHP, MySQL, WordPress

## System Administrator

I unblock users and developers with secure, sustainable, yet flexible solutions,
with deep experience in compliance, scripting, and automation across on-prem and
cloud infrastructure.

### DevSecOps Engineer - AX Enterprize (2021-present)

Administered the company's internal development and corporate IT environment,
including GitHub Enterprise, Harbor and Maven artifact registries, Entra ID
identity, Microsoft 365, and Cisco networking. Handled user lifecycle and access
control, endpoint patching, monitoring, backups, and day-to-day support for
business and engineering teams across on-prem and cloud infrastructure.
Maintained the build, release, and deployment automation that moves software
from developers to fielded sites.

Skills: Entra ID, M365, Cisco, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, CMMC

### Lead System Administrator - SUNY Polytechnic Institute (2012-2021)

Supported and maintained Linux infrastructure for business and academic
departments. Managed a VMware environment and a NetApp network file server.
Architected a solution for account and password synchronization across all
college systems and maintained the Single Sign-On solution. Administered Google
email and oversaw the migration from G Suite to Microsoft 365.

Skills: VMware, Cisco, Oracle Linux, FERPA, HIPAA

---

## Cyber Security

I offer secure solutions that minimize risk without standing in the way of
progress or productivity, spanning secure pipelines, identity, and DoD/DHS
compliance.

### DevSecOps Engineer - AX Enterprize (2021-present)

Owned the security posture of the product line and the internal development
pipeline. Maintained a secure software CI/CD pipeline with scanning integrated
throughout, triaging and remediating findings from Nessus, Snyk, OSCAP, and
other tools across source, containers, and deployed systems. Designed the
authentication and identity model, and led CMMC and DFARS compliance - including
STIG-hardened deployments and the POA&M/ATO documentation behind fielded
systems.

Skills: CMMC, Nessus, Entra ID, OSCAP/STIG, CI/CD, DFARS

### Lead System Administrator - SUNY Polytechnic Institute (2012-2021)

Sole owner of central authentication for the entire university, where every
student, faculty, and staff login flowed through one identity. Built and ran the
account and password synchronization and Single Sign-On that thousands of users
relied on daily. Conducted security audits, hardened and maintained secure
servers across academic and business systems, and kept FERPA- and
HIPAA-protected data secure.

Skills: Single Sign-On, Active Directory, Linux, FERPA, HIPAA
